headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Hayward ProLogic/AquaPlus pool controllers via RS-485 WiFi serial bridge. Requires the Python sidecar service — see sidecar/install.sh.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/homebridge-fun/homebridge-prologic) for wiring and setup instructions.

sidecarHost.title: Sidecar Host
sidecarHost.description: Host where the Python sidecar service is running (usually localhost on the same Pi).

sidecarPort.title: Sidecar Port
sidecarPort.description: Port for the Python sidecar REST API.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the sidecar for state updates.

circuits.title: Circuits to expose
circuits.description: Which circuits to expose as HomeKit switches.

enablePoolHeaterThermostat.title: Pool Heater Thermostat
enablePoolHeaterThermostat.description: Expose a Thermostat accessory for the pool heater with setpoint control.

enableTemperatureSensors.title: Temperature Sensors
enableTemperatureSensors.description: Expose read-only air and pool temperature sensors.
